name: Alex Moon
originStory: You were born to Karen Moon and Daniel Moon, married six years by the time you arrived. She was an office clerk, he was a postal worker. There was always food on the table and never quite enough for the rest. You were the youngest of 3: Susan and Elena were already running the house. Your father Daniel could talk his way into anywhere, and you watched him do it. In Amsterdam, in 2026. Nobody there had any idea what you would become.

timeline.text: Born in Amsterdam to Karen Moon and Daniel Moon — a getting by household.

productions.title: Paper Cousin
productions.premise: A daughter who stayed away too long comes back to a terrace due for clearance. A will leaves everything to one of them, and it is too late to be fair about it.

scene.hint: Push while it works. Stop before it does not.
scene.title: Paper Cousin
scene.line: The scene is not working and everybody knows it. You can keep pushing — every take finds something, until one of them does not.
scene.page: Today's pages: the middle of it — it is too late to be fair about it.
